title: Identification and verification of AK4 as a protective immune-related biomarker in adipose-derived stem cells and breast cancer.
authors: Lu, Wei; Yang, Zhenyu; Wang, Mengjie; Li, Shiqi; Bi, Hui; Yang, Xiaonan
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用GEO/TCGA数据构建ADSCs与乳腺癌的基因调控网络，虽含TF相关网络但核心为表达谱与预后标志物分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer (BC) remains the most common cancer among women, and novel post-surgical reconstruction techniques, including autologous fat transplantation, have emerged. While Adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs) are known to impact the viability of fat grafts, their influence on breast cancer progression remains unclear. This study aims to elucidate the genetic interplay between ADSCs and breast cancer, focusing on potential therapeutic targets. METHODS: Using the GEO and TCGA databases, we pinpointed differentially expressed (DE) mRNAs, miRNAs, lncRNAs, and pseudogenes of ADSCs and BC. We performed functional enrichment analysis and constructed protein-protein interaction (PPI), RNA binding protein (RBP)-pseudogene-mRNA, and lncRNA-miRNA-transcription factor (TF)-gene networks. Our study delved into the correlation of AK4 expression with 33 different malignancies and examined its impact on prognostic outcomes across a pan-cancer cohort. Additionally, we scrutinized immune infiltration, microsatellite instability, and tumor mutational burden, and conducted single-cell analysis to further understand the implications of AK4 expression. We identified novel sample subtypes based on hub genes using the ConsensusClusterPlus package and examined their association with immune infiltration. The random forest algorithm was used to screen DE mRNAs between subtypes to validate the powerful prognostic prediction ability of the artificial neural network. RESULTS: Our analysis identified 395 DE mRNAs, 3 DE miRNAs, 84 DE lncRNAs, and 26 DE pseudogenes associated with ADSCs and BC. Of these, 173 mRNAs were commonly regulated in both ADSCs and breast cancer, and 222 exhibited differential regulation. The PPI, RBP-pseudogene-mRNA, and lncRNA-miRNA-TF-gene networks suggested AK4 as a key regulator. Our findings support AK4 as a promising immune-related therapeutic target for a wide range of malignancies. We identified 14 characteristic genes based on the AK4-related cluster using the random forest algorithm. Our artificial neural network yielded excellent diagnostic performance in the testing cohort with AUC values of 0.994, 0.973, and 0.995, indicating its ability to distinguish between breast cancer and non-breast cancer cases. CONCLUSIONS: Our research sheds light on the dual role of ADSCs in BC at the genetic level and identifies AK4 as a key protective mRNA in breast cancer. We found that AK4 significantly predicts cancer prognosis and immunotherapy, indicating its potential as a therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌（BC）仍是女性中最常见的癌症，新型术后重建技术，包括自体脂肪移植，已应运而生。虽然脂肪来源干细胞（ADSCs）已知会影响脂肪移植物的存活率，但其对乳腺癌进展的影响仍不明确。本研究旨在阐明ADSCs与乳腺癌之间的遗传相互作用，重点关注潜在的治疗靶点。方法：利用GEO和TCGA数据库，我们确定了ADSCs和乳腺癌中差异表达（DE）的mRNA、miRNA、lncRNA和假基因。我们进行了功能富集分析，并构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）、RNA结合蛋白（RBP）-假基因-mRNA以及lncRNA-miRNA-转录因子（TF）-基因网络。我们的研究深入探讨了AK4表达与33种不同恶性肿瘤的相关性，并检查了其在整个癌症队列中对预后结果的影响。此外，我们仔细分析了免疫浸润、微卫星不稳定性和肿瘤突变负荷，并进行了单细胞分析，以进一步理解AK4表达的意义。我们使用ConsensusClusterPlus包基于核心基因识别了新的样本亚型，并检查了它们与免疫浸润的关联。随机森林算法用于筛选亚型间的DE mRNA，以验证人工神经网络的强大预后预测能力。结果：我们的分析确定了与ADSCs和乳腺癌相关的395个DE mRNA、3个DE miRNA、84个DE lncRNA和26个DE假基因。其中，173个mRNA在ADSCs和乳腺癌中均受共同调控，222个表现出差异调控。PPI、RBP-假基因-mRNA和lncRNA-miRNA-TF-基因网络提示AK4为关键调控因子。我们的发现支持AK4作为多种恶性肿瘤的有前景的免疫相关治疗靶点。我们基于AK4相关聚类使用随机森林算法识别了14个特征基因。我们的人工神经网络在测试队列中表现出优异的诊断性能，AUC值分别为0.994、0.973和0.995，表明其能够区分乳腺癌和非乳腺癌病例。结论：我们的研究在遗传水平上揭示了ADSCs在乳腺癌中的双重作用，并确定AK4为乳腺癌中的关键保护性mRNA。我们发现AK4显著预测癌症预后和免疫治疗反应，表明其作为治疗靶点的潜力。
